page.overview:
Who is Besh Turmin?

is the duergar owner and proprietor of Turmin's Tinctures and Tonics in Rosohna. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Turmin is a duergar dwarf with even gray skin, a permanent scowl on his face, and almost pupil-less white eyes. His hair is a deep red maroon color parted in the center, and he has a puff of red for a beard.

While somewhat combative, Turmin is willing to sell almost anything, at a substantial markup, even if he has to go elsewhere to buy it.

Turmin grew up in the Shadowshire of Rosohna.
